Fixed
Fixed an issue where ping values could jitter when using certain USB Wi-Fi dongles

This should help reduce the problem where the screen occasionally stutters every few dozen seconds when using Virtual Desktop.  

The issue had been affecting users since VR Manager v1.3.4, and this update addresses it.

If the issue persists, try using a wired connection between your PC and Wi-Fi router to improve stability.


Security

Added
Added Recommended Settings for VRChat feature.

Home > Quick Settings > Recommended Settings for VRChat

Added yaw drift correction status display. 

Advanced Settings > Yaw Drift correction strength > Tooltip

Added spine estimation, removed hip estimation.


Changed
Adjusted preview widget frame rate to reduce system load.

Improved confirmation dialog and UI when changing attachment points.


Deprecated

Removed

Fixed
Fixed feet splaying outward when ankles rotated in the yaw direction.

Fixed virtual tracker switching process not working when only the chest sensor was attached.

Fixed an issue where, after turning the ankle motion detection feature off, the foot did not register ground contact in some cases.

Fixed some text not updating immediately after changing the language settings.

Implemented a workaround for an issue where uninstalling the Shiftall Tracker (SteamVR driver) would fail in certain environments.


Security

Added

Changed
Always enable Thigh twist correction.

Improved ground contact sensation with ankle rotation (when distance sensor is disabled and foot sensor is not used)

Changed the default audio volume 1.0 -> 0.5
Deprecated

Removed

Fixed
Fixed an issue with Recenter Position Tracking while lying down

Optimized CPU performance

Fixed an issue that occurred when unintended firmware was selected during sensor firmware updates

Fix for memory leaks when using the GX dongle

Fixed an issue where the stick figure appeared in the wrong position when the HMD was not connected.

Addressed issue where disconnection could occur when using the GX dongle

Temporary workaround for some trackers not being detected in Resonite 

As a temporary workaround, detection can be enabled by adding the following launch option: --shortTrackerSerialNumber

Fixed an issue where YAW drift correction may not function properly
Security

With this update, the settings for "Feet burried correction" (default: disabled) and "Skating correction" (default: enabled) will be reset to their default values.

feature

 - Added a feature to set height based on HMD height

 - Fixed issue with KNEE virtual tracker not disabling when HaritoraX2 LEG sensor is disconnected

※ This release is the same as beta release 1.0.29.

Shiftall Tracker
Fixed issues with not working depending on PC environment. 

HaritoraX Wireless 2
Bulk mode switching operation improved.

GX dongle
Improved reconnection process after dongle updated.

Other performance improvements and bug fixes.

Shiftall VR Manager Upedates
 - Fixed an issue where the legs would spread apart during front reset. It should now work properly in a sitting position.
 - Made firmware updates less prone to failure by improving retry processes and error handling.
 - Fixed an issue where the legs would remain bent after a successful Mode 1 calibration. (Note: This adjustment may slightly decrease the success rate of Mode 1 calibrations).
 - Simplified the user interface by reducing the onscreen text volume by summarizing explanations for each item into "?" icons.

HaritoraX Wireless 2 Firmware Updates
 - Bundled sensor firmware version 1.0.19
  - Fixed an issue where the auto power off feature would not activate after 20 minutes when using a dongle and exiting the application.

※ Same as Beta version 1.0.14
